title: Tier Price per Thousand for Summit Top-Up Miles
content:
The tier price per thousand of a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program top-up purchase of miles follows the tier the member holds and whether that tier's validity runs through the day of the purchase, as the membership record's tier and valid-through date show them.

| Tier held | Validity runs through the day of the purchase | Tier price per 1000 miles (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman | Yes | 28 |
| Summit Platinum | Yes | 30 |
| Any other tier, or a tier not valid through that day | | 35, the program's price per 1000 miles purchased |

A tier's validity runs through the day of the purchase when its valid-through date is that day or later.

**Hypothetical cases.** A Summit Diamond member whose tier is valid through 31 January 2028 has a tier price per thousand of 28 USD. A Summit Platinum member whose valid-through date is the purchase day itself has 30 USD. A Summit Gold member has 35 USD.
